description: A new wave duo become stars.

title: Airpocalypse

description: The efforts of a crooked rancher to monopolize water rights are stymied by a young widow and a hired killer.

description: A gunfighter reconciles with his estranged mother to protect her from greedy land-grabbers.

title: Requiescant
description: The son of a Mexican bandit finds a village that is controlled by a former Confederate officer who steals from the locals.

title: Closed Circuit
description: During a local screening of a film, a patron is hit by an unexpected bullet, leaving the police to sift through a cinema full of potential culprits.

title: Shin Ultraman
description: After the accidental death of a human during battle, Ultraman takes on the man's appearance and place at the S-Class Species Suppression Protocol to protect Earth from further threats.

title: Opera
description: A hooded figure forces a young diva (Cristina Marsillach) to watch as he murders performers in a production of Verdi's opera "Macbeth."

title: The Bird With the Crystal Plumage
description: An American writer (Tony Musante) hunts for an elusive slasher after witnessing an attempted murder through the glass doors of a Rome art gallery.

description: Simone Scafidi examines the life and career of horror filmmaker Lucio Fulci.

title: Sand Sharks
description: A ravenous prehistoric predator is released from underground by an earthquake to terrorize people on land.

title: Ben
description: A boy, Danny, befriends a rat named Ben and forms an army of his rodent friends in the city drains. Under Ben's orders, the killer rats sweep through the city. The victims are numerous, the stores are devastated, and the population is terrorized.

title: Heaven's Burning
description: Gangsters and a vengeful husband (Kenji Isomura) pursue a Japanese bride (Yûki Kudô) and her newly found Australian lover (Russell Crowe).

title: Kung Fu Traveler 2
description: Gen. Chen goes back in time to the late Qing Dynasty to find the master of the northern style of kung fu.

title: Underground
description: In the midst of a spirited bachelorette party, friends find themselves on an unexpected and harrowing journey through an underground bunker complex, a long-forgotten fortification from World War II.

title: Death Kappa
description: Scientists create amphibious supersoldiers and detonate a nuclear bomb. In the midst of the fallout, a monster arrives, leaving Japan defenseless. Mankind's only hope is an irradiated water goblin with death on its mind.

title: A Bucket of Blood
description: A busboy is embraced by the beatnik art community when he develops an impressive but morbid method of sculpturing.

title: Burst City
description: Punk bands protest a nuclear power plant and are attacked by yakuza thugs until a pair of metal-clad bikers arrives.

title: The Grindhouse
description:
S01 E04 — The incredible 2 headed transplant
Bruce Dern is a mad doctor/scientist, and of course, nobody has ever seen a mad scientist in a movie before. He concocts a plan to take a dead head off one guy, and surgically attach it to another guy.
